raw_response: {"diagnosis": "raw_transactions has 5124 rows but only 4975 distinct txn_ids. Some transactions were delivered more than once across daily batches, and silver_transactions passes every copy through, so 143 POSTED txn_ids are duplicated and gold counts and totals are inflated. No duplicate rows are sampled, so I am assuming these are redeliveries or later versions of the same transaction, and I keep the latest delivered version per txn_id.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.62, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED'"}}
